sentences.en: Typicality means that when extracting the core semantic features of words, we just examine the stable and typical uses of the words, and exclude the temporary and special uses of the words in context.

sentences.en: And semantic typicality involves the interdependency of all the other members except the prototypical member in the category, which is the specific cognition of the meanings in all the sub-categories.

sentences.en: Typicality may be seen as functioning as the locus for the local stability of lexical meanings. In this sense it represents the habitual or regularity aspect of meaning.
